---
title: "A toy Delaunay graph"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

Generate a reproducible set of two-dimensional points, compute their Delaunay triangulation, and display the connections as an igraph network.

Source script: [R/DelaunayToy.R](../R/DelaunayToy.R). The code below retains the source script's order and comments.

## Setup

Enable evaluation and code display for all chunks, and resolve the source script's relative paths from the project root when knitting this file from the Vignettes folder.

```{r setup, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = normalizePath("..", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
)
```

## Load packages

Load the triangulation and graph libraries.

```{r step-01, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# 1. Install and load the required libraries
#install.packages(c("deldir", "igraph"))
library(deldir)
library(igraph)

```

## Generate sample coordinates

Use a fixed random seed to generate 20 points.

```{r step-02, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# 2. Create sample 2D points (X and Y coordinates)
set.seed(42)
points <- data.frame(
  x = runif(20, 0, 100),
  y = runif(20, 0, 100)
)

```

## Compute the triangulation

Triangulate the sample coordinates.

```{r step-03, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# 3. Compute the Delaunay Triangulation
triangulation <- deldir(points$x, points$y)

```

## Extract the edges

Retrieve the pairs of point indices that form the Delaunay edges.

```{r step-04, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# 4. Extract the edges (connections between points)
edges_matrix <- triangulation$delsgs[, c("ind1", "ind2")]

```

## Build the graph

Create an undirected igraph object from those pairs.

```{r step-05, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# 5. Build the igraph object
delaunay_graph <- graph_from_edgelist(as.matrix(edges_matrix), directed = FALSE)

```

## Plot the graph

Display the graph using the original point coordinates as its layout.

```{r step-06, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# 6. Plot the resulting graph
plot(delaunay_graph, layout = as.matrix(points), 
     vertex.size = 7, vertex.label = NA, vertex.color = "tomato")
```
